summary: Distinguish Bitcoin foreground and background work from balance-history bootstrap
details: Native progress panels label Core's active chain Bitcoin foreground and its historical validation Bitcoin background, keeping both distinct from the Balance history service. A ready foreground tip with incomplete observed background validation retains an explicit explanation even in compact output. Pre-snapshot Bitcoin (IBD) and legacy Bitcoin labels are preserved.

When chain startup is waiting on a refused or reset balance-history RPC connection, the compact panel explains the active baseline import, replay or verification stage if a running BH process has matching progress evidence written after that process started. Failed, stale, sealed or unknown bootstrap observations and other RPC errors retain their original diagnostics.

Expanded panels retain the underlying readiness probe error. Changes are confined to text presentation: progress JSON, readiness decisions, startup gates, resource allocation and service execution are unchanged.
